FAQs

Common questions.

Can't find what you need? Call us on (+675) 301 5480.

How do I open an account?+

Visit your nearest NBCL branch with a completed New Account Application Form, two forms of valid ID (such as National ID, passport or driver's licence) and your opening deposit: K5 for Fairer Access, K10 for Simpler or Smarter Access.

What are your branch opening hours?+

All branches except Vision City: Monday to Thursday 8:45am–3:00pm and Friday 8:45am–4:00pm. Vision City: Monday to Thursday 9:00am–3:00pm, Friday 9:00am–4:00pm, and Saturday–Sunday 9:00am–2:00pm.

I forgot my Online Banking password. What do I do?+

Select “Forgot Password” on the Online Banking login page and follow the prompts, or visit your nearest branch. After three wrong attempts your login is locked; follow the prompts or call us to reactivate it.

How do I get my one-time password (OTP) overseas?+

OTPs can be sent by WhatsApp, email or SMS. If you don't have your local SIM overseas, choose email or WhatsApp.

I sent money to the wrong NBCL account. Can you reverse it?+

The dispute must be lodged through the bank you sent the money from. Complete their dispute or reversal form; they'll contact NBCL, and we'll process any approved refund back through them.

Can I use my Lokol Visa Debit Card online?+

No. Online and contactless transactions are turned off on Lokol for your security. For online purchases, Simpler and Smarter Access customers can apply for the Classic Visa Debit Card.

What happened to *141# Anytime Banking?+

The USSD service has closed. Please use the NBCL Mobile App or Online Banking instead.
